beats.say: 90 years: Walter Koenig passed away at home in North Hollywood.
The actor died on Sunday 25 October 2026, according to the BBC.
He was the navigator Pavel Chekov in the original Star Trek television series.
Koenig also played the telepath Alfred Bester in the science fiction series Babylon 5.
He even wrote for the franchise, scripting a 1973 episode of the animated series.
William Shatner and George Takei paid tribute to a man who loved his community.
He leaves a legacy that spanned from the bridge of the Enterprise to the stars. What is your favourite Chekov moment?

facts: Walter Koenig died at the age of 90 on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at his home in North Hollywood.
He played Pavel Chekov in the original Star Trek television series.
He played the telepath Alfred Bester in Babylon 5.
He wrote a 1973 episode of Star Trek: The Animated Series.
William Shatner and George Takei paid public tributes to him.
